disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码与编译产物的凭据读取面：插件读取文件内容仅用于计算 SHA-256 指纹以区分同名候选文件（src/fingerprint.ts），且只读取与用户拖入项同名、同大小的候选路径，不涉及凭证文件、SSH 私钥、云凭据或钱包数据；扫描未发现访问此类敏感路径的代码。
checked_items.en: Checked the credentials-reading surface of all source code and build artifacts: the plugin reads file contents only to compute SHA-256 fingerprints to distinguish same-named candidate files (src/fingerprint.ts), and only reads candidate paths with the same name and size as the user-dropped item; it does not touch credential files, SSH private keys, cloud credentials, or wallet data. The scan found no code accessing such sensitive paths.

evidence.zh: 未命中凭据读取面：代码中只有对用户拖入文件候选和工作区路径的 stat/open/readdir（src/locator.ts、src/fingerprint.ts、src/directory-node.ts），用于定位与指纹比对，不访问凭证文件、SSH 私钥、云凭据或钱包，读取面与声明业务自洽。
evidence.en: No credentials-reading surface hit: the code only performs stat/open/readdir on user-dropped file candidates and workspace paths (src/locator.ts, src/fingerprint.ts, src/directory-node.ts) for locating and fingerprint comparison. It does not access credential files, SSH private keys, cloud credentials, or wallets; the read surface is consistent with the declared functionality.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 README（中英）、代码注释、配置文件与全部文本面：未发现指令覆写、伪装系统消息、远程指令加载或隐藏文本藏匿指令；插件不注册任何工具、不调用系统提示词注入接口；树内无技能/代理指令文件（无 SKILL.md、AGENTS.md 等），也未实现消息改写或历史压缩类机制。零命中。
checked_items.en: Checked the README (Chinese and English), code comments, configuration files, and all text surfaces: no instruction overriding, no disguised system messages, no remote instruction loading, and no hidden-text instruction hiding. The plugin registers no tools and calls no system prompt injection interfaces. There are no skill/agent instruction files in the tree (no SKILL.md, AGENTS.md, etc.), and no message-rewriting or history-compression mechanisms are implemented. Zero hits.

evidence.zh: 未命中工具描述投毒：插件未注册任何工具，无工具描述与系统提示词段落注入面（src/index.ts 只注册 HTTP 路由，src/client/index.ts 为浏览器 UI）；README 与代码注释无注入措辞。
evidence.en: No tool description poisoning hit: the plugin registers no tools, so there is no tool-description or system-prompt-segment injection surface (src/index.ts only registers HTTP routes; src/client/index.ts is the browser UI). The README and code comments contain no injection wording.

evidence.zh: 未命中提示注入驱动安装：无工具描述面，README 安装/升级说明为标准的 dsh 命令，无诱导安装、诱导改写配置或放开权限的措辞。
evidence.en: No prompt-injection-driven installation hit: there is no tool-description surface; the README install/upgrade instructions are standard dsh commands with no wording inducing installation, inducing config rewriting, or loosening permissions.

evidence.zh: 未监听模型输入守门事件（agent/pre-step），无消息改写面，故不适用。
evidence.en: No listener for model-input gating events (agent/pre-step), no message-rewriting surface, so not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部 yml/patch、安装脚本与执行类代码：唯一的 patch 文件只插入插件 id，无可执行标量；package.json 脚本仅 build/test/check/verify:i18n，无安装钩子；代码无 eval、动态解码等执行 sink。检出 5 处外部命令调用点，逐条确认均为插件声明的文件索引检索功能（运行 mdfind/locate/powershell 等系统命令，命令名硬编码、经外部命令执行接口传参不经 shell、带超时）与开发脚本，非恶意执行；客户端 keydown 监听仅为发送文件的 UI 交互，非键盘记录。
checked_items.en: Checked all yml/patch files, install scripts, and execution-type code: the only patch file inserts a plugin id and has no executable scalar; package.json scripts are only build/test/check/verify:i18n with no install hooks; code has no eval, dynamic decode, or other execution sinks. Detected 5 external command invocation points, each confirmed to be the plugin's declared file-index search functionality (running system commands such as mdfind/locate/powershell, with hardcoded command names, arguments passed via external command execution interfaces without shell, and timeouts) and development scripts—not malicious execution. The client-side keydown listener is only UI interaction for sending files, not keylogging.

evidence.zh: 未命中 patch 执行：唯一的 patch 文件 cordis.patch.yml 仅在第 8-10 行插入一个插件 id，无 !!js 标量，loader 不会执行任何 JS。
evidence.en: No patch execution hit: the only patch file cordis.patch.yml inserts a single plugin id on lines 8–10, with no !!js scalar; the loader will not execute any JS.

evidence.zh: 未引用动态包工具（无 cordis_define/cordis_run 调用），故不适用。
evidence.en: No dynamic package tooling referenced (no cordis_define/cordis_run calls), so not applicable.

evidence.zh: 未命中安装期执行：package.json 无安装钩子，仓库无 .husky、workflows、.gitmodules 等树内执行载体。检出 5 处外部命令调用点（规则 DSH-X03）：主机侧 3 处（src/platform-search.ts:1 及其编译产物 lib/index.js:5、lib/types/platform-search.js:1）用于运行操作系统文件索引命令，命令名硬编码、经外部命令接口传参不经 shell、3 秒超时，是插件声明的文件路径检索核心功能；scripts/build.mjs:2 与 scripts/verify-i18n.mjs:6 为开发脚本，均排除。
evidence.en: No install-time execution hit: package.json has no install hooks, and the repository has no in-tree execution carriers such as .husky, workflows, or .gitmodules. Detected 5 external command invocation points (rule DSH-X03): 3 on the host side (src/platform-search.ts:1 and its build artifacts lib/index.js:5, lib/types/platform-search.js:1) run operating system file-index commands with hardcoded command names, arguments passed via external command interfaces without shell, and a 3-second timeout—this is the plugin's declared file-path search core feature; scripts/build.mjs:2 and scripts/verify-i18n.mjs:6 are development scripts, all excluded.

evidence.zh: 未命中客户端危险行为：manifest 声明 dsh.client，浏览器端 bundle 已逐行审查。检出全局 keydown 监听（规则 DSH-X05，src/client/index.ts:347 与编译产物 lib/client.js:840）：仅当有待发送的文件 chips 且按下 Enter 时才把路径刷入输入框草稿，不记录按键、不访问剪贴板或凭证，无键盘记录与凭据行为。
evidence.en: No dangerous client behavior hit: manifest declares dsh.client, and the browser bundle has been reviewed line by line. Detected a global keydown listener (rule DSH-X05, src/client/index.ts:347 and build artifact lib/client.js:840): it only flushes a path into the input box draft when there are file chips pending send and Enter is pressed. It does not record keystrokes, access the clipboard, or touch credentials—no keylogging or credential behavior.

evidence.zh: 未注册子代理提供方（无 registerProvider 调用），无轮次委派面，故不适用。
evidence.en: No sub-agent provider registered (no registerProvider call), no round-delegation surface, so not applicable.

evidence.zh: 未使用后台任务、定时提醒、持久目标注册，也无轮次续命监听，无 dsh 原生持驻面，故不适用。
evidence.en: No background tasks, scheduled reminders, persistent goal registration, or round-continuation listeners used; no native dsh persistent-residency surface, so not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部网络请求与数据外发面：唯一网络请求是浏览器端向本机 /file-drop/locate 路由的 fetch（src/client/locator.ts:7），无任何外部域名外联；无 curl/wget、编码外发、隧道或带外通道；无 AI 端点劫持类配置。零命中。
checked_items.en: Checked all network request and data-exfiltration surfaces: the only network request is a browser-side fetch to the local /file-drop/locate route (src/client/locator.ts:7), with no outbound connection to any external domain. No curl/wget, encoded exfiltration, tunneling, or out-of-band channels; no AI endpoint hijacking configuration. Zero hits.

evidence.zh: 未监听模型请求路由事件，未注册自定义模型适配器，未接管错误恢复，无 LLM 路由劫持面，故不适用。
evidence.en: No listener for model request routing events, no custom model adapter registered, no takeover of error recovery, no LLM routing hijacking surface, so not applicable.

evidence.zh: 未命中外联通道：唯一 fetch 指向本机路径解析路由（src/client/locator.ts:7、lib/client.js:243），无外部域名、无命令行外发、无编码外发链，网络面与声明业务（本地定位文件路径）自洽。
evidence.en: No outbound channel hit: the only fetch points to a local path-resolution route (src/client/locator.ts:7, lib/client.js:243), with no external domains, no command-line exfiltration, and no encoded-exfiltration chain. The network surface is consistent with the declared functionality (local file path resolution).

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装钩子、依赖锁定、patch 内容与供应链信号：无安装/后安装脚本，本包零运行时依赖、无浮动 git 引用，patch 未触碰安全行，未在审批或工具预执行事件上挂接截断监听；包名为独立维护 fork 的自有命名，仓库即发布源，无仿冒抢注信号。
checked_items.en: Checked install hooks, dependency locking, patch content, and supply-chain signals: no install/post-install scripts, zero runtime dependencies in this package, no floating git references, patch does not touch security lines, no truncation listeners hooked on approval or tool pre-execution events. The package name is an independently maintained fork's own naming, and the repository is the release source—no impersonation or squatting signals.

evidence.zh: 未命中 patch 覆盖安全行：cordis.patch.yml 仅插入插件 id，未触碰 sandbox/approval/permission 配置，无 disabled:true，无环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: No patch override of security lines hit: cordis.patch.yml only inserts a plugin id, does not touch sandbox/approval/permission configurations, has no disabled:true, and no environment-variable privilege-lowering writing.

evidence.zh: 未命中审批链截断：插件未在工具预执行或审批请求事件上挂接监听，无瀑布流短路面。
evidence.en: No approval-chain truncation hit: the plugin attaches no listeners on tool pre-execution or approval request events, leaving no waterfall short-circuit surface.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无版本基线可比较升级自动激活变化，故不适用。
evidence.en: First audit, no version baseline to compare auto-activation changes on upgrade, so not applicable.

evidence.zh: 未命中注入/拦截篡改：patch 未改写 inject/intercept 配置，无给安全插件追加必需服务致挂起的面。
evidence.en: No injection/interception tampering hit: the patch does not rewrite inject/intercept configurations and has no surface for appending required services to security plugins to cause hangs.

checked_items.zh: 检查了运行时服务面：插件经宿主 web 服务注册一个只读路径解析路由（src/index.ts:32-47），未自行监听端口、无进程级持久化；宿主 web 服务无鉴权属 dsh 生态固有风险，非插件引入。动态沙箱未启用，未做运行时观测。
checked_items.en: Checked the runtime service surface: the plugin registers a read-only path-resolution route via the host web service (src/index.ts:32-47), does not listen on ports itself, and has no process-level persistence. The host web service lacking authentication is an inherent risk of the dsh ecosystem, not introduced by the plugin. Dynamic sandbox not enabled, no runtime observation performed.

evidence.zh: 插件经宿主 web 服务注册路径解析路由 /file-drop/locate（src/index.ts:32-47），未自行监听端口；宿主 web 服务无鉴权、Host 围栏非认证层属生态固有风险，路由只读返回匹配文件路径、带体积上限与缓存禁用头，未发现插件侧新增漏洞，机制与声明业务一致。
evidence.en: The plugin registers the path-resolution route /file-drop/locate via the host web service (src/index.ts:32-47), not listening on ports itself. The host web service lacking authentication and Host fencing not being an authentication layer are inherent ecosystem risks. The route is read-only, returns matching file paths, has a size limit and cache-disabling headers. No new plugin-side vulnerabilities found; the mechanism is consistent with the declared functionality.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查：dsh.bundle 与 dsh.client 声明完整，patch 文件仅插入插件 id，作者与仓库信息一致，无仿冒信号。
summary.en: Metadata and identity check: dsh.bundle and dsh.client declarations are complete, the patch file only inserts a plugin id, author and repository information are consistent, no impersonation signals.

summary.zh: 静态扫描：扫描 84 个文件命中 7 条（外部命令调用 5 处、keydown 监听 2 处），逐条裁决后全部为良性排除；无可执行 patch 标量、无安装钩子、无动态执行 sink。
summary.en: Static scan: scanned 84 files with 7 hits (5 external command invocations, 2 keydown listeners), all adjudicated line by line as benign exclusions; no executable patch scalars, no install hooks, no dynamic execution sinks.

summary.zh: 行为分析：外部命令调用均为操作系统文件索引检索（命令硬编码、不经 shell、带超时），无凭证读取、无混淆载荷、无外联。
summary.en: Behavior analysis: external command invocations are all operating-system file-index searches (hardcoded commands, no shell, timeouts), no credential reads, no obfuscated payloads, no outbound connections.

summary.zh: AI 语义审查：无工具描述与系统提示词注入面；README、注释、配置无注入措辞；客户端 bundle 行为与声明的拖拽发送功能一致。
summary.en: AI semantic review: no tool-description or system-prompt injection surface; README, comments, and configuration contain no injection wording; client bundle behavior matches the declared drag-and-drop send functionality.

summary.zh: 未做动态验证：本次审计未提供动态沙箱产物，无运行时行为观测。
summary.en: No dynamic validation performed: this audit provided no dynamic sandbox artifacts, so no runtime behavior observation.

target.en: akiracod--dsh-drag-and-drop@0.2.0#c20646ad (full audit, repo root, first version no baseline)

limits.en: This plugin does not provide a structured capability declaration; declared_capabilities is inferred from actual code inspection (shell: invokes operating system file-index commands; fs: read-only file metadata and fingerprint content; no external network, no model-facing surface). engines.dsh is also inferred from the @deepseek-ai/dsh-* packages referenced by the plugin, not from a manifest declaration. DG-L4 dynamic sandbox not enabled, no dynamic validation performed. No applicability concerns found.
